action: Opens on the finished head: separate pointed hair locks, a thick scarf ring around the neck, eyes with carved double lid lines, and frown furrows between the brows.
tool: ZBrush viewport (shelf: Morph, Inflat, TrimCurve, SO_Det, makkon, MaskPen, MaskLasso, Smooth, SelectRect, SelectLasso, ClipCurve)
why: Show the target before the process.

action: In close-up, carves the upper-lid line as a thick raised ridge with a groove under it, and cuts the brow hairs as short tapered grooves.
why: Anime lid lines are sculpted as hard relief so they read in clay.
reader_equivalent: Crease (subtract) + Pinch along the lid; Draw Sharp for brow strokes

action: Process restart: the head begins as a low DynaMesh egg/tapered block with a domed top and a narrowing chin.
why: The simplest volume with the head-to-chin taper.
reader_equivalent: UV sphere scaled to a tapered egg + low voxel remesh

action: Cuts the block into hard planes: a flat front face plane, flat sides, a chamfered top and an angled chin.
tool: TrimCurve / ClipCurve planar cuts (TrimCurve on shelf, inferred use)
why: Box the anime head into front/side/top planes.
reader_equivalent: Bisect plane cuts or Trim Line, at voxel size coarse

action: Re-DynaMeshes at higher resolution and roughs the planar box into a skull with eye-socket shading and a pointed chin, keeping corner planes visible.
why: Go from planar to rounded skull without losing the plane breaks.
reader_equivalent: Voxel remesh finer; Clay Strips + Grab

action: Adds ears as flat discs on the side, a narrow triangular nose, down-turned mouth line, eyelids and frown brows.
why: Place all features at low detail and check them from the front.

action: Draws dark strokes over the brows and a band from the eye to the ear, apparently as a paint guide for the brow and lid shapes.
why: Mark where the brow and lid lines go before carving them.
reader_equivalent: Sculpt-mode Paint or Annotate tool as guide

action: Carves the eyes into the clay: thick dark upper-lid line, round irises with highlight rings, and a lower lid line.
why: Large anime eyes with graphic lid lines.
reader_equivalent: Crease + Draw; color attribute for line darkening

action: Front view of a high-res bald head with symmetrical frown brows, closed eye shapes, small nose and mouth; the ZRemesher and SDiv panels are on screen.
tool: DynaMesh at high res; ZRemesher/subdivision panel visible
why: Check symmetry and proportion from straight front.
reader_equivalent: Front ortho view with symmetry X; Multires or voxel remesh

action: Glitch transition back to the finished head with hair.
